purpose: Next-CST-date interaction planning only; this artifact is not a runtime queue and cannot authorize a wallet request.

identity.release_identity_rule: Every release row displays the Basename and full primary address; current resolution or ownership requires release-time official readback.

global_execution_rules.daily_30_eligible_receipt: Unique successful Base Mainnet state-changing receipt from the configured Base Account / Smart Wallet only.
global_execution_rules.testnet_and_vibenet_counting: Always false for the daily 30 floor.
global_execution_rules.simulation_counting: Always false; simulation is L0 and not_broadcast.
global_execution_rules.erp_readback_boundary: ERP posting or settlement closure requires an authoritative readback bound to the same caseId and fingerprint; chain receipt alone is not ERP meaning.

deduplication.duplicate_rule: A consumed or resolved fingerprint cannot be retried or counted unless the owner contract proves a new independent business outcome.
deduplication.pending_rule: A transaction hash, request id, or pending receipt never releases the replay lock or increments a counter.
deduplication.receipt_identity_rule: Receipt transactionHash, chainId, sender, target/action and final state change must match the locked packet.

publication_bundle.x_twitter: read_only_research_input; never a publication platform or counter

lanes.purpose: Meaningful primary Smart Wallet contract, payment, registry or settlement state change with a unique receipt.

eligible_when: primary Base Account / Smart Wallet sender matches exactly
receipt status is success and final
target, calldata hash, value and action semantics match the locked packet

stop_conditions: Base MCP namespace or trusted Smart Wallet provider unavailable
primary identity or Base Mainnet capability mismatch
exact target/calldata/value/gas packet unresolved
owner-visible review surface missing, blank or spinner-only
receipt pending, null, reverted, non-final, reorged or non-unique
duplicate/replay-locked fingerprint
ERP readback missing or bound to another case

lanes.purpose: Validate product routing, receipt parsing and ERP failure modes without claiming a Mainnet interaction.

controls: no production promotion from test receipt

receipt.promotion_rule: Use as L2 evidence only after deterministic product readback.

stop_conditions: Any attempt to count the testnet receipt toward daily 30
network or wallet identity mismatch
unsupported contract or swap route
receipt not final or product readback nondeterministic

lanes.purpose: Experiment with B20 roles, cap, pause, policy and permit semantics on the experimental network only.

controls: no production liquidity or user-facing claim

receipt.promotion_rule: L2/L0 experimental evidence only; never a Mainnet receipt.

stop_conditions: Network is not Vibenet
B20Factory or feature capability is not confirmed
role/cap/pause/policy semantics are ambiguous
experimental result is about to be presented as production evidence

lanes.purpose: Keep HTTP 402 requirement, maxPayment, authorization, fulfillment and receipt as separate evidence objects.

eligible_when: the payment itself is a unique successful Base Mainnet Smart Wallet state change
the payment packet passes the same receipt and dedup rules as the Mainnet lane

receipt.promotion_rule: Payment receipt and HTTP fulfillment are separate; neither substitutes for ERP meaning.

stop_conditions: maxPayment or merchant/resource binding is missing
authorization is stale, reused or exceeds cap
payment receipt is pending or not final
fulfillment cannot be bound to the same request

lanes.purpose: Separate deployment identity, call calldata, emitted events and ERP settlement readback.
stop_conditions: bytecode, constructor or target hash changes after review
network mismatch
receipt status is not final success
contract readback or ERP binding is missing

lanes.purpose: Perform only a reviewed Mainnet swap with explicit assets, amount, slippage and treasury reconciliation.

eligible_when: unique final successful Smart Wallet Mainnet state change
exact quote/call and slippage packet match

stop_conditions: testnet or unsupported chain
quote, slippage or asset identity changes
liquidity or gas risk exceeds owner ceiling
token balance/readback does not match the reviewed outcome
